programme.title: NUMBERBLOCKS
programme.desc: Numberblocks is an educational animated series for preschoolers that teaches mathematical concepts through lively, adventurous number block characters. Each number block has its own numerical value and unique personality. They join forces and interact with each other to solve mathematical problems while teaching basic mathematical concepts such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and other concepts. Each episode of “Numberblocks” typically features a short story in which the number blocks work together to complete a task or face a mathematical challenge. Through songs, engaging stories, and bright visuals, the series aims to introduce and reinforce children's understanding of numbers and basic mathematical concepts in a fun and interactive way.

programme.title: PINKFONG & FRIENDS
programme.desc: Each episode features a new story that is both entertaining and educational, with interactive moments that invite children to guess, sing, and share in the joy with the characters.

programme.title: TAYO, THE LITTLE BUS
programme.desc: In a big city where various vehicles happily coexist, the little bus Tayo has just started learning his route around town. There are many things for Tayo to learn. Tayo and his friends, Rogi, Lani, and Gani, help each other to become great grown-up buses.

programme.title: KATURI
programme.desc: Katuri is an exciting show about four peacock chicks growing up in a natural forest under the gentle care and affection of Mother Flora. Mother Flora always encourages her children to explore the world with other animals and helps them whenever they need it. When the peacock chicks encounter difficulties or even danger, Mother Flora is always there to keep them safe.

programme.title: PORORO, THE LITTLE PENGUIN
programme.desc: Pororo the little penguin and his friends live in a peaceful land covered in snow and ice. They all have different personalities and interests, which sometimes cause a little trouble in their quiet winter world. But together, every day is an adventure where they learn all of life's lessons, big and small!

programme.title: BING
programme.desc: Let's get to know Bing, a cute and curious little rabbit! Together with his beloved adult friend, Flop, Bing always finds exciting new things every day. From playing with bubbles, tying shoelaces, to overcoming sadness, everything becomes a fun adventure! Come on, follow the adventures of Bing and his friends! We can learn many things while laughing, you know!

programme.title: BLUEY
programme.desc: Bluey is an Australian animated series that follows the daily adventures of a six-year-old blue heeler puppy named Bluey. Together with her younger brother, Bingo, and her parents, Bandit and Chilli, Bluey engages in imaginative games that spark curiosity and creativity.

programme.title: TIAN TIAN
programme.desc: A simple family from the big city decides to leave the glitz and glamour of urban life behind and return to the village for the sake of their child, who is afraid to go to school. In the village, they interact with friends, neighbors, and local animals, causing endless awkward and funny situations. However, amid all the silliness, there are also touching moments of togetherness, where laughter and tears go hand in hand. Tiantian, the six-year-old child, full of curiosity and love for the world, begins to develop into a healthy, independent, and confident person amidst the beauty of the countryside.

programme.title: CIPUNG ABUBU
programme.desc: It all began with the birth of Rayyanza Malik Ahmad (Cipung), the second son of Raffi Ahmad and Nagita Slavina, who brought happiness to everyone, even his cousins Zayn and Zuney. However, unlike Rafathar, the eldest child, he felt jealous because he thought all the attention was being taken by Cipung. Then a miracle happened when fairy dust touched Cipung, Rafathar, Zayn, and Zuney. The fairy dust transformed the babies into magical babies and took them to the world of Boba, a place for children where all miracles can happen and without adults knowing. From that moment on, the adventure began. Together with the Boba, the creatures who work there, they created magical tools and encountered various amazing creatures such as tauge monsters, viruses, zombies, snowmen, and even met Supercool, who heightened the adrenaline of their adventure.

programme.title: RAINBOW BUBBLEGEM
programme.desc: In the underwater world, a mermaid named Purple longs for adventures on land and secretly takes a huge risk by transforming herself into a human. With the help of Pink Star, the sleeping guardian fairy of the bubblegem, Purple transforms. However, the excessive use of magic causes the bubblegem, their source of power, to shatter and scatter across the land. To gather the scattered bubblegems, the sea queen White Gold commands seven mermaids from different sea kingdoms.

programme.title: SUNNY GIRL NO.23
programme.desc: **SUNNY GIRL NO.23** is not only about the growth journey of a cheerful young girl, but also the first realistic-themed animated series that reflects parent-child education and school life in China. The main character is an 8-year-old elementary school student. She is not extraordinary. She is a clumsy girl, but also energetic, optimistic, and kind-hearted, with a talent for drawing, creativity, and problem-solving abilities that many children can relate to. This animation has been well received by audiences in Mainland China and has also been distributed across Southeast Asia, including Malaysia and Vietnam. The first season expresses a worldview through 26 humorous stories: *"There are many different forms of excellence, and every child is exceptional in their own way."* It not only portrays the childhood experiences of contemporary elementary school students but also explores the clash between traditional and modern parenting concepts. The second season continues and further develops this worldview.

programme.title: NEW KELUARGA SOMAT NEW SEASON
programme.desc: FOLLOW THE EXCITING ADVENTURES OF PAK SOMAT’S FAMILY AS THEY BEGIN A NEW LIFE IN CITEKO! FROM BUILDING BU INAH’S DREAM FOOD STALL, TO THE HILARIOUS UPS AND DOWNS OF LIVING NEXT DOOR TO CEU KOKOM, AND PAK SOMAT’S STRUGGLE TO BECOME AN ONLINE MOTORCYCLE TAXI DRIVER FOR HIS FAMILY. A HEARTWARMING STORY FULL OF LAUGHTER AND MORAL LESSONS FOR ALL AGES.

programme.title: BIOSKOP KELUARGA INDONESIA (PORORO DAN KECERIAAN DESA PORONG PORONG!)
programme.desc: Follow the adventures of Pororo, the curious little penguin, together with Crong, Poby, Eddy, and their friends in Porong Porong Forest. Together, they solve problems and learn new things every day.

programme.title: POKEMON SEASON 19: XYZ
programme.desc: THE POKÉMON XYZ ANIMATED SERIES IS PART OF THE POKÉMON FRANCHISE AND FOLLOWS THE ADVENTURES OF ASH KETCHUM, PIKACHU, AND THEIR FRIENDS IN THE KALOS REGION. IN THE SERIES, ASH AIMED TO ACHIEVE VICTORY IN THE KALOS LEAGUE WHILE EXPLORING DIFFERENT CITIES AND MEETING MANY NEW FRIENDS. AS THEIR ADVENTURES CONTINUE, THEY FACE CHALLENGES, ENGAGE IN EPIC BATTLES, AND ENCOUNTER LEGENDARY POKÉMON. THE STORY ALSO HIGHLIGHTS THE STRONG FRIENDSHIP BETWEEN ASH AND HIS FRIENDS, AS WELL AS THEIR POKÉMON CHARACTER DEVELOPMENT.

programme.title: KELUARGA SOMAT

programme.title: PLENTIS KENTUS
programme.desc: PLENTIS KENTUS IS A POPULAR INDONESIAN CHILDREN'S ANIMATION WITH CHEERFUL AND UPbeat SONGS. THEY WERE CREATED AS A FORM OF INNOVATION IN THE CHILDREN'S MUSIC INDUSTRY IN INDONESIA. PLENTIS AND KENTUS ARE TWO BEST FRIENDS WHO ARE STILL IN ELEMENTARY SCHOOL. BOTH HAVE BIG DREAMS TO BECOME FAMOUS SINGERS. THEY LOVE SINGING, COMposing SONGS, AND PERFORMING AT VARIOUS EVENTS. THEIR ADVENTURES ARE FULL OF FUN, FRIENDSHIP, AND OF COURSE, LOTS OF SONGS THAT CAN MAKE CHILDREN SING AND SHOOT.

programme.title: BEDU DAN ADUL
programme.desc: BEDU AND ADUL IS A 3D ANIMATED FILM SERIAL ABOUT THE ADVENTURES OF CHILDREN IN THE MULTICULTURAL SUBURBS OF JAKARTA. THEIR INQUIRIES MAKE THEM WANTED TO EXPLORE, SOMETIMES CAUSING A FUCKING FUCK.

programme.title: MADUN
programme.desc: The Madun series tells the story of Madun (16 years old) and his journey to achieve his dream of becoming a soccer player. His father, Syafei (50 years old), who is of Medan descent, really wants his son to become an Islamic teacher. Because of this, Syafei always hinders Madun's efforts to achieve his dream. For him, Madun only has one choice, which is to become a religious scholar. Madun's mother, Kirana, a native of Batavia, is torn. She must obey her husband, who is anti-soccer. However, on the other hand, she also does not want to prevent Madun from realizing his dreams. She cannot bear to restrain Madun, who loves soccer. However, to realize his dream, Madun faces a lot of competition.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: Oddbods is an animated, slapstick comedy that embraces adventure and celebrates friendship. Following the wacky adventures of eight unique and furry friends, who laugh, play and get up to mischief in their hometown of Oddsville, where even the most ordinary of situations have unexpected outcomes.

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Little Angel is an animated musical show for pre-schoolers. The show has been captivating families around the world with its cheeky humor and catchy upbeat songs.

programme.title: COCOMELON IND
programme.desc: With Indonesian-language 3D animations and songs, Cocomelon creates a world centered around the everyday experiences of young children. In addition to helping preschoolers learn letters, numbers, animal sounds, colors, and more, the videos provide lessons in social skills. They give parents the opportunity to teach and play with their children as they watch together.

programme.title: PORORO AND TAYO SONGS
programme.desc: Watch music videos for Pororo, Tayo, and their friends!

programme.title: NUMBERBLOCKS
programme.desc: Numberblocks is an educational animated series for preschoolers that teaches mathematical concepts through lively, adventurous number block characters. Each number block has its own numerical value and unique personality. They join forces and interact with each other to solve mathematical problems while teaching basic mathematical concepts such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and other concepts. Each episode of “Numberblocks” typically features a short story in which the number blocks work together to complete a task or face a mathematical challenge. Through songs, engaging stories, and bright visuals, the series aims to introduce and reinforce children's understanding of numbers and basic mathematical concepts in a fun and interactive way.

programme.title: PINKFONG & FRIENDS
programme.desc: Each episode features a new story that is both entertaining and educational, with interactive moments that invite children to guess, sing, and share in the joy with the characters.

programme.title: TAYO, THE LITTLE BUS
programme.desc: In a big city where various vehicles happily coexist, the little bus Tayo has just started learning his route around town. There are many things for Tayo to learn. Tayo and his friends, Rogi, Lani, and Gani, help each other to become great grown-up buses.

programme.title: KATURI
programme.desc: Katuri is an exciting show about four peacock chicks growing up in a natural forest under the gentle care and affection of Mother Flora. Mother Flora always encourages her children to explore the world with other animals and helps them whenever they need it. When the peacock chicks encounter difficulties or even danger, Mother Flora is always there to keep them safe.

programme.title: PORORO, THE LITTLE PENGUIN
programme.desc: Pororo the little penguin and his friends live in a peaceful land covered in snow and ice. They all have different personalities and interests, which sometimes cause a little trouble in their quiet winter world. But together, every day is an adventure where they learn all of life's lessons, big and small!

programme.title: BING
programme.desc: Let's get to know Bing, a cute and curious little rabbit! Together with his beloved adult friend, Flop, Bing always finds exciting new things every day. From playing with bubbles, tying shoelaces, to overcoming sadness, everything becomes a fun adventure! Come on, follow the adventures of Bing and his friends! We can learn many things while laughing, you know!

programme.title: BLUEY
programme.desc: Bluey is an Australian animated series that follows the daily adventures of a six-year-old blue heeler puppy named Bluey. Together with her younger brother, Bingo, and her parents, Bandit and Chilli, Bluey engages in imaginative games that spark curiosity and creativity.

programme.title: TIAN TIAN
programme.desc: A simple family from the big city decides to leave the glitz and glamour of urban life behind and return to the village for the sake of their child, who is afraid to go to school. However, amid all the silliness, there are also touching moments of togetherness, where laughter and tears go hand in hand. Tiantian, the six-year-old child, full of curiosity and love for the world, begins to develop into a healthy, independent, and confident person amidst the beauty of the countryside.

Power begets enemies and a loved ones betrayal cuts like a knife. Sides will be chosen, wars will be fought. In the end, there can only be one King.

programme.title: In Isolation
programme.desc: Four friends wanted to get away in a remote country house but when a mysterious man turns up and telling tales of a city ravaged by a epidemic and the looters who have pursued him, the friends rally to help.

programme.title: Shock And Awe
programme.desc: A group of journalists of the Knight-Ridder covering President George W. Bush's planned invasion of Iraq in 2003 are skeptical of the President's claim that Saddam Hussein has 'weapons of mass destruction.'

programme.title: You're Not Alone
programme.desc: An evil entity begins to torment a mother and daughter, who are forced to face the inexplicable presence that inhabits the walls of their new home.

programme.title: Shut In
programme.desc: When a young mother is barricaded inside a pantry by her violent ex-boyfriend, she must use ingenuity to protect her two small children from escalating danger while finding an escape.

programme.title: Among The Shadows
programme.desc: A private investigator must unravel the murder of her uncle while keeping the secret that she is a descendant from a line of werewolves.

programme.title: Gravy
programme.desc: It's All Hallow's Eve. A trio of costumed misfits with very special dietary requirements seizes a Mexican cantina and force the staff to engage in a late night of gaming, food and libations. The only caveat is what's on the menu.

programme.title: Intruder
programme.desc: During one of Oregon's most violent storms, a young cellist seeks solitude and comfort in the safety of her large apartment, but soon realizes she might not be home alone.

programme.title: War Pigs
programme.desc: A ragtag unit of misfits known as the War Pigs must go behind enemy lines to exterminate Nazis by any means necessary.

programme.title: Burial Ground Massacre
programme.desc: A group of college students spend a night at an old, eerie manor, only to realize that a terrifying stalker is watching their every move as he begins plans to repossess an ancient Native American artifact located inside.

programme.title: Elizabeth Harvest
programme.desc: Elizabeth arrives with her brilliant scientist husband Henry to his magnificent estate. Henry explains that everything in his world now belongs to her, all except for a locked-off room he forbids her from entering.

programme.title: Operation Seawolf
programme.desc: The German Navy and the last remaining U-Boats, were formed together for one last mission to attack the United States Homeland.

programme.title: While We Sleep
programme.desc: After observing a hauntingly familiar abnormal CAT scan of a 13 year old girl, radiologist Nina Evanko battles to find the source of the young girl's sleeping disorder. What she discovers is darker and stranger than she could have imagined.

programme.title: Don't Kill It
programme.desc: An ancient demon terrorizes a tiny Mississippi town.

programme.title: Old Henry
programme.desc: A farmer takes in an injured man with a satchel of cash. When a posse comes for the money, he must decide who to trust. Defending a siege, he reveals a gunslinging talent calling his true identity into question.

programme.title: Skin
programme.desc: A destitute young man, raised by racist skinheads and notorious among white supremacists, turns his back on hatred and violence to transform his life, with the help of a black activist and the woman he loves.

programme.title: The Retaliators
programme.desc: An upstanding pastor uncovers a dark and twisted underworld as he searches for answers surrounding his daughter's brutal murder.

programme.title: Crime Story
programme.desc: An old man suffering from cancer seeks revenge on the thieves who have destroyed his life.

programme.title: Stowaway
programme.desc: A tenacious party girl fights to survive after three thieves commandeer her luxury yacht. Unable to escape, she turns the tables on the intruders and takes matters into her own hands.

programme.title: Riot
programme.desc: Cop Jack Stone robs a Russian mob bank to end in the same prison as the mob boss killing Jack's wife. An inmate helps him as does a reporter. Lots of fights.

programme.title: Beneath Us
programme.desc: The American Dream becomes a nightmare for a group of undocumented day laborers hired by a wealthy couple.

programme.title: Death In Texas
programme.desc: Just out of prison, Billy Walker returns to El Paso to find his mom dying of liver failure but low on the transplant list. However, the border offers other, darker options.

programme.title: The Room
programme.desc: In San Francisco, an amiable banker's seemingly perfect life is turned upside down when his deceitful fiancée embarks on an affair with his best friend.

programme.title: The Super
programme.desc: A man becomes the superintendent of a large New York City apartment building where people mysteriously go missing.

programme.title: American Rider
programme.desc: Two bikers head from L.A. to New Orleans through the open country and desert lands, and along the way they meet a man who bridges a counter-culture gap of which they had been unaware.

programme.title: Behaving Badly
programme.desc: Rick Stevens has a crush on Nina Pennington. They form a friendship and take a rock'n'roll journey together while Nina deals with her overbearing boyfriend Kevin.

programme.title: The Journey Is The Destination
programme.desc: Photographer Dan Eldon, was only 22 when he was killed by an angry mob in Somalia. He left behind 17 scrapbooks that held his art, chronicling his life from age 14.

programme.title: 5 Cewek Jagoan
programme.desc: Yanti contacts her four friends who have special skills to rescue her, Hardi, Hardi's mother and her younger sibling who are taken hostage by Broto and his gang.

programme.title: Karmila
programme.desc: Adapted from a popular novel with the same title, Karmila tells a story about a medical student who becomes pregnant after sexually assaulted at a party.

programme.title: Video Maut
programme.desc: Doni's plan to bring his girlfriend, Maya, to a secluded villa is to make video the two of them in bed, and to sell it to Alvin for distribution on the Internet. But, his plan go awry when Maya brings her friends.

programme.title: Skandal
programme.desc: Mischa, who bored with her marriage, find her life changes when she sees Vincent, her former lover. But he is so possessive that he insists on continuing the relationship and starts to threaten Mischa's family.

programme.title: Dear Jo: Almost Is Never Enough
programme.desc: After the tragic death of Maura, Ella and Joshua's lives are shattered as Ella carries Maura's child, navigating grief, parenthood, and unexpected challenges.

programme.title: Hotline 666
programme.desc: Erza is a pizza deliverer who never believed in fairy tales. One day, he get order to deliver pizza to a haunted house and locked overnight in there.

programme.title: Cewek Gokil

programme.title: Cinta Tapi Beda (IMC)

Blending compelling character drama with a behind-the-scenes look at Japan's entertainment industry, Oshi no Ko Season 2 explores talent, obsession, and the price of pursuing the truth.

programme.title: New Taiwan Online
programme.desc: New Taiwan Online is a Taiwanese current affairs talk show produced by Sanlih News. programme.title: Just Eat: Fun Fishing
programme.desc: A lifestyle series combining the excitement of fishing with culinary adventures. Each episode explores scenic fishing destinations, catches fresh seafood, and transforms it into delicious local dishes while discovering regional culture and unique flavors.

programme.title: The Sound Of Happiness
programme.desc: The Sound of Happiness follows the Wu family, led by a respected police officer and his supportive wife. Although he once dreamed of having a son to continue the family legacy, he instead dedicates his life to guiding his four daughters through the joys and hardships of adulthood. As their lives become intertwined with romance, ambition, betrayal, and family rivalries, the family faces countless trials that test their love and resilience. Blending heartfelt relationships with dramatic twists, the series delivers an emotional story about family bonds, forgiveness, and perseverance.

programme.title: The Tradition Story Of Taiwan
programme.desc: Discover the fascinating traditions and folklore of Taiwan in The Tradition Story of Taiwan. Each episode delves into ancient legends, local customs, religious beliefs, historical figures, and cultural practices that continue to shape Taiwanese identity today. Combining storytelling with visits to historical sites and local communities, the program offers viewers an engaging journey through Taiwan's diverse cultural heritage and enduring traditions.

programme.title: Taste Of Life
programme.desc: Taste of Life follows the Zhao family, owners of a century-old soy sauce business built on tradition and hard work. As the aging patriarch searches for a successor, his children become entangled in complicated relationships, family rivalries, business conflicts, and personal ambitions. Amid romance, heartbreak, betrayal, and redemption, every family member must decide whether to preserve their family's legacy or pursue their own dreams. Through its emotional storytelling, the series celebrates perseverance, forgiveness, and the enduring strength of family bonds.

programme.title: Stylish Man: The Chef

programme.title: Tiger Island S1, Ep 1
programme.desc: On a remote island in Nepal's Bardiya National Park, a team of wildlife filmmakers and tiger experts embarks on a groundbreaking expedition to uncover the secret lives of one of the highest concentrations of wild tigers on Earth. Using cutting-edge drone technology, thermal cameras, and remote filming equipment, they follow two tigresses—Goma and Mala—as they raise their cubs and navigate the challenges of survival in a territory ruled by powerful predators. The series reveals extraordinary and previously unseen tiger behavior, offering an intimate look into the lives of these elusive big cats and the remarkable conservation success that has helped their population thrive.

programme.title: Collision Course, Ep 1
programme.desc: Collision Course unravels the speculation surrounding car and airplane crashes involving celebrities. Footage from the scene, police records, CGI reenactments and interviews with eyewitnesses provide a detailed look at what put these celebrities on a collision course.

programme.title: Legend Of Mining And..., Ep 1
programme.desc: In 1973, a discovery was made beneath Tonglu Mountain in China’s Hubei Province: 13 bronze axe-heads made thousands of years ago. But it wasn’t just their age that made them stand out: they were huge, the largest weighing in at more than 16kg - three times bigger than the largest modern-day axe-heads

programme.title: Foodwise: Haikou
programme.desc: Welcome to Haikou, also known as the Coconut City! Join Tianran experiencing the culinary culture and urban character of this tropical paradise. From light and sweet coconut chicken hotpot to refreshing herbal desserts and spicy rice soup.

programme.title: Art In The Field
programme.desc: The youth of a country is the future of that country. A series of documentaries focusing on the younger generation of China in which you get to see what they are achieving and what makes them tick!

programme.title: The Elegance Of Luoyang
programme.desc: Luoyang, as the eastern starting point of the Silk Road, is a city with a rich history and a tradition of cultural inclusivity. As such, it enjoys a prominent position in the heritage of the whole world.

programme.title: Cultural Inheritors, Ep 7
programme.desc: Fearful that traditional culture and skills might fade with the generations, Gulixian left behind her enviable job in a big city and returned to her hometown of Turpan, Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region. Starting from scratch, she and her husband began creating short videos, exploring rural areas to find inheritors of intangible cultural heritage.

programme.title: Fall In Love With Museums, Ep 3
programme.desc: Museums preserve and record human civilization and art, and traces of existence can be found in every dusty history. In museums of all sizes in the United States, Chinese cultural relics also tell their own stories.

programme.title: Wisdom's Breath, Ep 4
programme.desc: Real life stories told from the personal perspective. Moving, dramatic, sorrows and joys, expressed emphatically and expressed quietly. Watch closely to see and understand the real China as it is lived.

programme.title: Beijing Daxing Int'l..., Ep 3
programme.desc: In 3 days, Beijing Daxing International Airport will face a pressure test - its biggest challenge before going into operation. Everyone is busy preparing for it. programme.desc: Inspired by true events, À Bicyclette ! follows Mathias, who decides to retrace the cycling route his late son once dreamed of completing—from France to Turkey. Joined by his longtime friend Philippe, the pair sets off on an emotional road trip filled with laughter, challenges, and meaningful encounters across Europe. As the miles pass, the journey becomes more than a physical adventure; it transforms into a deeply personal quest for healing, friendship, and acceptance. Blending gentle comedy with emotional drama, the film celebrates resilience and the enduring power of human connection.

programme.title: LES MAINS SALES
programme.desc: LES MAINS SALES portrays a tense power struggle within a political movement, where loyalty and personal ambition collide. Inspired by the play by Jean-Paul Sartre, the story explores moral dilemmas and the consequences of political action in a turbulent society.

programme.title: EAUX TURBULENTES
programme.desc: Eaux Turbulentes follows police investigator Marianne Desbiens as she returns to Queensbury after a career setback. Tasked with investigating the suspicious death of a young Indigenous woman, Marianne finds herself confronting not only a complex criminal case but also painful memories from her own past. As clues emerge, the investigation exposes hidden tensions within the community, family secrets, and unresolved conflicts that have shaped the town for years. Combining crime, suspense, and emotional drama, the series explores themes of justice, identity, family, and reconciliation.

programme.title: Kiko
programme.desc: Kiko tells of a child of a goldfish who is very independent, even though he is an only child. Kiko who is always cheerful has four good friends, namely Lola the discus fish, Ting Ting the crab, Patino the catfish and Poli the betta fish. On the other hand, the antagonists, Karkus the catfish and Pupus the eel, always make Kiko's life chaotic. One day, the lake where Kiko lives is polluted due to the reckless acts of humans, causing Kiko and friends to turn into mutants.

programme.title: Uang Kaget Lagi Dobel Kagetnya S1 E5

programme.title: The One S1 E1
programme.desc: One of the SMBG team members suddenly left the team a week before registration for the Fights of Legend professional league closed. Robin and SMBG members (ZEE, ABBY, SACHA, ODRIE) rushed to find new members. Until finally Robin found a replacement for his team member, namely Bara, a former pro-player who had been accused of cheating in matches.

programme.title: The One S1 E2
programme.desc: There was a division among SMBG members, should they accept Bara or not? Sacha mediated the debate by persuading team members to accept Bara. After being convinced by Robin, Bara was willing to rejoin the SMBG team. However, the SMBG team has not fully united yet, especially since they received news that their registration for the professional league was rejected.

programme.title: The One S1 E3
programme.desc: SMBG registration was rejected because of Bara's track record of cheating in professional matches. Zee wants Bara to leave, but Bara's decision to stay is unanimous. The only route the SMBG team can take to enter the professional league is by winning the semi-professional league.

programme.title: The One S1 E4
programme.desc: The SMBG team started to gain popularity because of Bara. Robin also appointed Bara as captain to boost the team's popularity. This creates a tense atmosphere between Bara and Zee. However, the SMBG team continued to win match after match until they advanced to the final round despite these conditions.

programme.title: The One S1 E5
programme.desc: The SMBG team received bad news that funds from their investors were blocked for an undetermined amount of time. With their respective strengths, the SMBG team members finally worked together to raise money to support team operations.

programme.title: The One S1 E6
programme.desc: Zee received an offer from Indra in the form of money and luxury facilities if he wanted to join the Archon team. Zee has not agreed to this, but this makes it difficult for him to concentrate on carrying out activities with the SMBG team, he is often absent because of the distractions given by Indra. This causes a rift within the SMBG team.

programme.title: The One S1 E7
programme.desc: Bara began to reveal signs of Zee's closeness to the Archon team. The entire team was gathered to share all their feelings and problems while joining the SMBG team. Even though it was filled with various loud arguments, in the end they realized that the whole team was a family and had to be united.

programme.title: The One S1 E8
programme.desc: Robin managed to overcome interference from the Archon team. Now the SMBG team is ready to face the regional final which will make them champions. In the final, it turns out they faced the Archon team.

programme.title: TLC: TV, Love, Cinema S1 E1
programme.desc: Hadid is an only child and heir to a wine-producing vineyard. At a party, Hadid meets Quinta, the plantation student who steals her heart. To find out the sincerity of the woman who loves him, Hadid hides his true identity by posing as an ordinary employee in his own vineyard office.

programme.title: Menggapai Ikatan Cinta S1 E1
programme.desc: A visit to the set of Ikatan Cinta was the most exciting activity for Diva. Unfortunately, Nada kept forbidding her to do anything related to Ikatan Cinta, for no apparent reason. Nada also forced Diva to diligently work on college assignments with Fahmi, her little friend.

programme.title: Menggapai Ikatan Cinta S1 E2
programme.desc: Ravi teams up with Miss Belma, Diva's lecturer, to organize a MIC (Menggapai Ikatan Cinta) casting roadshow on campus. In the midst of her enthusiasm for the event, Diva is intrigued by the secret of Abang, Nada's ex-boyfriend who has been covered up. Diva manages to find information that Abang works in the movie industry.

programme.title: Menggapai Ikatan Cinta S1 E3
programme.desc: In order to get closer to Ravi, Diva decided to join the MIC roadshow committee. During the preparation for the event, Fahmi seemed a bit jealous of the different Diva's attitude in front of Ravi, becoming softer and more feminine. Meanwhile, Nada asks Beni to accompany Diva to and fro, preventing her from doing anything related to Ikatan Cinta.

programme.title: Menggapai Ikatan Cinta S1 E4
programme.desc: Knowing the fact that all this time Nada had lied to her, Diva kept her distance and was reluctant to interact with Nada. Diva couldn't resist asking Nada about the figure of "Abang", but Nurul always stopped her. Realizing how antagonistic Nada is with Ikatan Cinta, Diva and Nurul speculate that Diva's biological father played a role in Ikatan Cinta.

programme.title: Menggapai Ikatan Cinta S1 E5
programme.desc: Diva was very enthusiastic and nervous when she acted together with Surya Saputra, unfortunately she didn't have time to talk about her relationship. Diva also chases Surya's car, but she failed because Fahmi's motorbike is pulled over by a debt collector.

programme.title: Menggapai Ikatan Cinta S1 E6
programme.desc: Sad to find that Surya Saputra is not her father, Diva is pacified by Ravi by taking her to a romantic place. When Ravi makes her fall in love even more, Diva is touched by Fahmi's efforts to help her solve Abang's mystery. Thanks to Fahmi's help, Diva found out that Abang was not an actor, but a film crew.
